business_problem: ingest and standardize huge volumes of battery diagnostic data from diverse partners so Elysia could optimize battery performance, detect faults earlier, and scale without heavy engineering overhead.
solution_summary: Elysia uses Snowflake and Snowpark on Snowflake to ingest and standardize huge volumes of battery diagnostic data from diverse partners so Elysia could optimize battery performance, detect faults earlier, and scale without heavy engineering overhead. Machine, product, erp, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so operations and engineering teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Snowpark keeps transformation and application logic close to the governed data instead of forcing the team to move workloads into separate compute environments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Elysia achieved 30% longer battery lifetime and 10B+ diagnostic data points collected.
